title: Claude Code Isn't Just a Terminal — It's 6 Surfaces
description:
You think Claude Code is just a terminal CLI. It's actually six surfaces — terminal, desktop app, VS Code, JetBrains, web at claude.ai/code, and your phone via Remote Control in the Claude mobile app — all hitting the same Claude with the same conversation, tools, and memory.

Start a long agent run on your laptop, walk away, watch it from your phone on the train, resume in your IDE. Pick the surface for the moment, not the lock-in.

Episode 1 of the Claude Code Shorts series — practical Claude Code in 60 seconds.
